text:
People Ops: Short thread to capture remaining questions from today's all-hands about reviews, leveling, promos, comp, and benefits  drop quick Qs here. :wave:

Jules R: If a manager missed nominating someone for this cycle but confirms they met the bar, what's the cleanest way to correct?

People Ops: Best path: manager submits a retro promotion request using the promo template and marks it 'retro-fasttrack'. Include 1page justification + 2 evidence items (OKRs, shipped work). Comp team aims for a 10-business-day review for fast-track cases. Payroll retro pay possible; include payroll note.

Kiran P: Are calibration meetings still live? Any chance to make them hybrid/recorded for async folks?

Maya (CTO): Calibrations will be hybrid. We'll record the summary decisions and publish anonymized outcomes. The initial ranking step will be blinded; names only revealed when required to resolve edge cases.

Jules R: One last thing  template link for promos?

Payroll Bot: Promo template: https://intranet.redwood.example/promo-template. Remember: effective date within current quarter for standard processing.

People Ops: Thanks  we'll fold these into the FAQ and post the updated rubric next week. Office hours if you need a private convo: https://calendar.redwood.example/peopleops-officehours.
